text: The User Interface Designer is tasked with designing a menu that covers all functions.
User feedback highlights dissatisfaction with current remote controls’ look-and-feel and learnability, and notes that remotes are frequently misplaced in rooms.
There is uncertainty about how the project file is saved, including whether auto-save exists and where files are stored.
The target user group is defined as sixteen to forty years old.

Decisions specify no teletext (except for TV_T_), removal of teletext and newsflash features, retention of all classic remote functions with improved usability, and the requirement that the product incorporate corporate identity with logo and consistent colours.
